_comment: Questions of the reported MultiCaRe-Dx consultations, verbatim (Chinese; the agent answers in the language of the question).

turns.t1:
患者资料：{presentation}
这是活检/切除标本的 H&E 图像。最可能的诊断是什么？请给出一个最可能的诊断，并列出 2-3 个鉴别诊断及理由。
turns.t2: 为了确诊，应该做哪些免疫组化、特殊染色或分子检查？预期结果是什么？
turns.t3: 类似病例通常如何治疗？文献报道的随访和结局如何？

english_gloss.t1: Patient information: {presentation}. This is an H&E image of the biopsy / resection specimen. What is the most likely diagnosis? Give one most likely diagnosis and list 2-3 differential diagnoses with reasons.
english_gloss.t2: Which immunohistochemistry, special stains or molecular tests should be done to confirm the diagnosis, and what results are expected?
english_gloss.t3: How are similar cases usually treated? What follow-up and outcomes are reported in the literature?
